nodes.label: Domain routing reference (plugin copy)
nodes.rationale: Domain routing is agent-driven, not hardcoded: the backend classifies each question against the four evidence domains before retrieving, and retrieves only from domains that actually apply, because routing to only relevant domains keeps the allowlist check meaningful and avoids irrelevant citations diluting a claim's grounding. A single question may span multiple domains, but each resulting claim still carries exactly one evidence_domain tag.
